subject.title: fix(ui): prevent chat jump when the working claw appears

question: Should this protected Control UI fix proceed after refreshed browser proof on the current merge result, or should its identity/cache lifecycle receive an additional owner review first?
rationale: The patch addresses a subtle virtualized-rendering transition, the branch is behind the base, and the supplied evidence acknowledges that no real browser execution completed.

options.title: Request refreshed browser proof
options.body: Rebase the branch and provide a redacted live browser trace, recording, or diagnostic output demonstrating stable row identity and geometry through acknowledgement and first streaming.

options.title: Owner-review the lifecycle path
options.body: Have a Control UI owner inspect the working-progress cache reset and stream handoff before accepting mocked coverage as sufficient.

recommendation.title: Request refreshed browser proof
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch and provide a redacted live browser trace, recording, or diagnostic output demonstrating stable row identity and geometry through acknowledgement and first streaming.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the proposed UI identity lifecycle and its test coverage, though independent history routing remains low confidence.
